# Repository ownership map

As of 2026-10-27. Every active Outer-Void repository, its authority, what it never owns, its interface and its
integration boundary. `blux` column: integrated (part of BLUX), standalone (works alone, BLUX can call it), optional
(BLUX can add value, never required) or excluded (deliberately independent of BLUX).

## `blux`: BLUX

- **Owns:** Contract v1, the capability registry and policy, Model API v1 and routing, Hook System v1, the runtime, the direct `blux` CLI, the training data pipeline and Gen 0 evaluation harness
- **Never owns:** Device control, receipt persistence, audits, discovery, repository creation, product business truth
- **Interface:** `blux` CLI (one JSON document per machine command), blux-sdk (Python), contracts/v1 schemas
- **Integration boundary:** Calls engines as subprocesses (ADR-0009) and providers only through the Model API; emits receipts to BLUX System through its CLI (ADR-0008)
- **Depends on:** `blux-system`, `blux-gpt`

## `blux-system`: BLUX System

- **Owns:** Execution truth: receipts, operation graph, timelines, artifact references, replay metadata, retention
- **Never owns:** Reasoning, planning, orchestration, policy decisions
- **Interface:** `blux-system` CLI (one JSON document per command), Python API
- **Integration boundary:** Receives receipts from BLUX via its CLI; consumers read through `show/list/graph/timeline`; depends on blux-sdk pinned to a commit
- **Depends on:** `blux`

## `blux-gpt`: BluxGPT

- **Owns:** Provider transport behind Model API v1: retries, streaming, normalization
- **Never owns:** Agent loops, tool execution, routing across providers, ecosystem authority
- **Interface:** `bluxgpt blux-model-backend` (Model API backend protocol), `bluxgpt` CLI
- **Integration boundary:** Invoked only by the BLUX Model API router as a subprocess backend

## `blux-coga`: CogA

- **Owns:** Deterministic structured reasoning with replayable artifacts
- **Never owns:** Model identity; hidden chain-of-thought (never stored)
- **Interface:** `coga` / `blux-coga` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (reason.analyze, reason.compare, reason.critique, reason.decompose, reason.plan, reason.rank, reason.risk)
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone engine; BLUX and `ax reason` call it as a subprocess

## `blux-ca`: cA

- **Owns:** Construction, modification and repair changesets with rollback
- **Never owns:** Certifying its own work (DAT validates)
- **Interface:** `ca` / `blux-ca` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (artifact.construct, artifact.modify, artifact.repair, artifact.validate, code.patch, repo.patch, config.generate)
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone engine; called by BLUX and `ax build`; hands validation to DAT
- **Depends on:** `dat`

## `dat`: DAT

- **Owns:** Independent audit, security, quality and release gates
- **Never owns:** Fixing what it finds
- **Interface:** `dat` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (repo.audit, repo.security, repo.quality, repo.release, package.audit, artifact.audit, policy.verify)
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone; may reject any component's work; called by cA, BLUX and `ax audit`

## `lrc`: LRC

- **Owns:** Deterministic repository creation, scaffolding and migration
- **Never owns:** Certifying itself
- **Interface:** `lrc` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (repo.create, repo.scaffold, repo.migrate, repo.compile, repo.validate)
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone; called by `ax create` and BLUX

## `god`: GOD

- **Owns:** Discovery of projects, capabilities and commands (reads `.blux/` through blux-sdk)
- **Never owns:** Executing anything it discovers
- **Interface:** `god` CLI and `.blux/` capabilities (registry.index, capability.discover, capability.describe, capability.compat, project.describe, command.discover)
- **Integration boundary:** Read-only; called by `ax projects/capabilities` and BLUX App
- **Depends on:** `blux`

## `blux-app`: BLUX App

- **Owns:** Local mission control: read-only views over the BLUX tools; read-only BLUX System checks as its only controls
- **Never owns:** Execution, enforcement, any BLUX logic
- **Interface:** `blux-app serve|snapshot` (127.0.0.1 web UI and JSON API)
- **Integration boundary:** Calls `blux`, `blux-system`, `god`, `voidforge` executables only
- **Depends on:** `blux`, `blux-system`, `god`

## `blux-ca-dataset`: cA dataset

- **Owns:** cA evaluation/training records produced by the pinned cA engine, with splits, locks and canaries
- **Never owns:** Training data from private sources
- **Interface:** `python -m dstool build|validate`, data/*.jsonl
- **Integration boundary:** Read by the Gen 0 harness and the routing studies; never copied into other repositories
- **Depends on:** `blux-ca`, `dat`

## `blux-coga-dataset`: CogA dataset

- **Owns:** CogA evaluation/training records produced by the pinned CogA engine, with splits, locks and canaries
- **Never owns:** Training data from private sources
- **Interface:** `python -m dstool build|validate`, data/*.jsonl
- **Integration boundary:** As the cA dataset
- **Depends on:** `blux-coga`

## `axiom`: AXIOM (`ax`)

- **Owns:** The developer control plane: routes each command to the authoritative engine (exit 69 when missing); the `axiom` cockpit identity
- **Never owns:** Reimplementing any engine; the AXIOM Launcher (that is void.os)
- **Interface:** `ax` CLI (`ax routes`, `ax doctor`, `ax env|reason|build|create|audit|projects|inspect|capabilities|devices|ask|agent`)
- **Integration boundary:** Routes only; each engine stays the authority

## `blux10k`: blux10k

- **Owns:** Environment and toolchain authority (`ax env`) and dotfiles
- **Never owns:** Project or device work
- **Interface:** `blux10k` CLI, dotfiles
- **Integration boundary:** Called by `ax env`

## `jadis.toolbox`: JADIS Toolbox (`jadis`)

- **Owns:** This workstation: environment classification, doctor, journaled local repairs, bootstraps, snapshots; four standalone personal scripts
- **Never owns:** Dotfiles, routing, audits, discovery, devices, intelligence
- **Interface:** `jadis` CLI, `.blux/` (4 read-only capabilities)
- **Integration boundary:** BLUX may read its four read-only capabilities; it can never reach repair, bootstrap or restore

## `voidforge`: VoidForge

- **Owns:** Android device work: ADB, Fastboot/fastbootd, sideload, flashing, Magisk, its journal and local authorization
- **Never owns:** Being directed by BLUX: BLUX and `ax devices` can only ask; writes need the person at the device
- **Interface:** Android app; `voidforge` integration client (ping, describe, devices, call; ask only)
- **Integration boundary:** Local integration endpoint; every write is confirmed on the device; members-only distribution

## `void.os`: AXIOM Launcher

- **Owns:** Launcher behavior and state, the bundled VOID.SYS and AXIOM Shooter surfaces (vendored at locked commits)
- **Never owns:** Requiring BLUX; being `ax`
- **Interface:** Android app
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone; vendors void.sys and void.game with drift checks; optional BLUX layer is Stage 27 (skipped)
- **Depends on:** `void.sys`, `void.game`

## `void.sys`: VOID.SYS

- **Owns:** The icon system and its standalone icon pack
- **Never owns:** BLUX intelligence (deliberately independent)
- **Interface:** Android icon pack
- **Integration boundary:** Vendored by the AXIOM Launcher at a locked commit

## `void.game`: AXIOM Shooter

- **Owns:** The game core (authoritative) and its standalone Android app
- **Never owns:** BLUX intelligence (deliberately independent)
- **Interface:** Android app; core library
- **Integration boundary:** Vendored by the AXIOM Launcher as a hidden Easter egg

## `roughin`: Roughin

- **Owns:** Contractor business truth: clients, jobs, invoices, payments, subscriptions
- **Never owns:** Delegating money or business truth to BLUX
- **Interface:** Web app (FastAPI + React PWA)
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone; BLUX may only assist in future, never own financial state

## `vigyl`: Vigyl

- **Owns:** Care-group truth: members, roles, tasks, escalation, timeline
- **Never owns:** Medical decisions; delegating care responsibility to BLUX
- **Interface:** FastAPI backend and React care-workspace development preview
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone; any BLUX assistance is suggest-only

## `resolver`: Resolver (Telegram bot)

- **Owns:** Telegram moderation runtime: moderation, entitlements, payments, admin cockpit
- **Never owns:** Marketing pages (that is theresolver)
- **Interface:** Telegram bot, admin web app
- **Integration boundary:** Standalone; its website never reads or reports its runtime state

## `ov-webpages/theresolver`: Resolver website

- **Owns:** Marketing, acquisition, support, privacy and terms pages for the bot
- **Never owns:** Bot runtime state, pricing truth (the bot's catalogue is authoritative)
- **Interface:** Static site (Cloudflare Pages)
- **Integration boundary:** Links into Telegram only; prices checked against the bot by script; independent release lifecycle

## `termux-background`: Termux Background

- **Owns:** Termux Monet wallpaper CLI and Android companion
- **Never owns:** BLUX integration (excluded)
- **Interface:** `termux-background` CLI, Android app
- **Integration boundary:** Companion talks to Termux through RUN_COMMAND only

## `ov-webpages/bluxai.app`: bluxai.app

- **Owns:** The private BLUX workspace: organizations, roles, run/receipt inspection, API tokens, audit, opt-in remote runs
- **Never owns:** Any BLUX runtime logic
- **Interface:** HTTP API (FastAPI)
- **Integration boundary:** Calls the BLUX executables only; can be switched off without affecting local BLUX
- **Depends on:** `blux`, `blux-system`

## `ov-webpages/operationrestore`: Operation: Restore website

- **Owns:** The operationrestore.net static site
- **Never owns:** Anything outside that site
- **Interface:** Static site
- **Integration boundary:** None

## `ov-webpages/ivrp`: IVRP website

- **Owns:** Reserved Inner Void Recovery Program website (README and LICENSE only)
- **Never owns:** Clinical or crisis services
- **Interface:** None yet
- **Integration boundary:** None

## `credits`: Credits ledger

- **Owns:** Attribution, licensing and provenance ledger; validation tools
- **Never owns:** Licence texts it does not own (kept verbatim)
- **Interface:** `tools/validate.py --org-root`, YAML catalog
- **Integration boundary:** Every repository's notices and AI-assistance records are reconciled here

## `docs`: Central docs

- **Owns:** This constitution, the status matrix, findings, legal baselines
- **Never owns:** Repository-specific specifications (those stay in their repositories)
- **Interface:** Markdown; `tools/build_status_matrix.py`, `tools/build_constitution.py`
- **Integration boundary:** Links to canonical sources; never copies specs that can drift

## `.github`: Organization profile

- **Owns:** The public organization profile and doctrine
- **Never owns:** Product status (the matrix is authoritative)
- **Interface:** GitHub profile README
- **Integration boundary:** Reads from the matrix and findings

## `.github-private`: Private organization profile

- **Owns:** The members-only organization profile
- **Never owns:** Anything public
- **Interface:** GitHub profile README
- **Integration boundary:** None

## `secret-project/er`: Eden Recovery

- **Owns:** Canonical Eden Recovery architecture, source IVRP workups, Restore integration model, feasibility and evidence gates
- **Never owns:** Autonomous clinical decisions or public website runtime; no care delivery authority from repository tests
- **Interface:** Versioned planning documents, source manifests, illustrative finance model and integrity checks
- **Integration boundary:** Public IVRP and Operation: Restore consume only explicitly approved exports; BLUX supports optional non-clinical work only

## Not active

- `blhermes-agent`: Archived fork of Nous Research hermes-agent (MIT); replaced by BLUX; reference only
- `secret-project`: Private workspace excluded except owner-authorized secret-project/er; never inspect other contents
